description: Servicio WMS (Web Map Service) Zonas de captación de las zonas sensibles (Q2023. Dir 91/271/CEE) is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by wms.mapama.gob.es. The WMS Service (Web Map Service) called "Areas of capture of sensitive areas (Q2023. Dir 91/271/EEC)"allows the visualisation and consultation of the data set representing watersheds or catchment areas of Sensitive Areas, according to Directive 91/271/EEC on urban wastewater treatment, version Q2023 (status data as at December 2022 reported to the European Commission in 2024). Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "WMS Service (Web Map Service) Capture areas of sensitive areas (Q2023. Dir 91/271/EEC)" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
